LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_ScoutUniform.label: Guerrilla Scout Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_ScoutUniform.description: Guerrilla scouts' uniforms, unfortunately, they don't have time to play baseball.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_EliteScoutUniform.label: Guerrilla Elite Scout Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_EliteScoutUniform.descriptio: Elite scouts' uniforms, which uses a special mushroom fabric material, is expensive and powerful, and remains lightweight.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderUniform.label: Guerrilla Member Suit
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderUniform.description: The uniforms of the Ratkin Underground guerrillas. They are the main combat force of the guerrilla group, fighting with medium-range weapons while also being responsible for carrying out infiltration operations.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderBag.label: Radio Backpack
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderBag.description: A portable radio used for communications with the command center, and it can also call for ground strikes.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainUniform.label: Guerrilla Commissar Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainUniform.description: The uniform of the political commissar, they are responsible for political propaganda and mechanical repair.
LanguageData.RKU_CombatMotivation.label: Inspiration
LanguageData.RKU_CombatMotivation.description: Units near the political commissar will receive an incentive effect.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainCloak.label: Guerrilla Captain Cloak
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainCloak.description: The guerrilla cloak has some ballistic resistance, but it is relatively heavy.
